$comment_file: Health Coach Bot — User Profile Schema (Alpha v1). One profile per user, keyed on telegram_id. Fields marked REQUIRED must be present at onboarding; everything else fills in over time. See two HARD STORAGE RULES at the bottom.

profile.age_confirmed_18_plus: true  // REQUIRED. No profile exists unless this is true. Store the boolean gate result ONLY — never an age or date of birth.

constraints.$comment: REQUIRED at onboarding — must be ASKED even if the answer is 'none'. Never assume 'none' without asking.
therapies: string  // clinical treatments that affect supplement timing, etc.
constraints.eating_disorder_flag: boolean | null  // FLAG ONLY — turns on safe behavior. Never store details.

targets.max_deficit_kcal: 500  // hard ceiling the coach must respect

coach_notes.note: string  // observed patterns, free text, e.g. 'protein consistently low on weekends'

$HARD_STORAGE_RULES: 1. Never store that a user is under 18. If a user is not confirmed 18+, no profile is created at all. Store the boolean gate result, never an actual age or date of birth.

2. Never store disordered-eating or self-harm details. The eating_disorder_flag boolean is the ONLY representation of that category — a switch that turns on safe behavior, never the details themselves.
